...

...

% Constraints
...

% or solve minimize or solve maximize

The generated code should always print the solution in JSON format using as keys the decision variables as given in the parentheses in the problem description, and the only values allowed are integers (or booleans) and lists of (lists of ...) integers (or booleans). % Include necessary libraries
include "globals.mzn";

% Define the number of steps in the stair
int: total_steps = 20;
set of int: allowed_steps = {3,4,5};

array[1..total_steps] of var 0..5: steps;

constraint forall(i in 1..total_steps) (
    steps[i] = 0 \/ steps[i] in allowed_steps
);

% The sum of all non-zero steps must equal the total steps
constraint sum( [steps[i] | i in 1..total_steps] ) == total_steps;

% The first move cannot be 0 (must start climbing)
constraint steps[1] != 0;

% Once a 0 is encountered, all subsequent steps must also be 0
constraint
    forall(i in 1..total_steps) (
        (steps[i] = 0) -> 
        (forall(j in i+1..total_steps) (steps[j] = 0))
    )
;

% Solve to satisfy the constraints
solve satisfy;

% Output the solution in JSON format
output [
    "{",
    join(",", [
        "\"" ++ "steps" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [show(steps[i]) | i in 1..total_steps]) ++ "]"
    ]),
    "}"
];
```

];

        "\"layout\": " ++ show([ [var_slots[t, v] | v in 1..n_var] | t in 1..n_templates ])

];

include "globals.mzn";

int: deck_width = 5;
int: deck_length = 5;
int: n_containers = 3;
array[1..n_containers] of int: width = [5, 2, 3];
array[1..n_containers] of int: length = [1, 4, 4];
array[1..n_containers] of int: classes = [1, 1, 1];
array[1..2, 1..2] of int: separation = array2d(1..2, 1..2, [0, 0, 0, 0]);

% Decision variables
array[1..n_containers] of var 0..deck_width: left;
array[1..n_containers] of var 0..deck_width: right;
array[1..n_containers] of var 0..deck_length: bottom;
array[1..n_containers] of var 0..deck_length: top;

% Constraints
% 1. Container dimensions must match
constraint forall(i in 1..n_containers) (
    right[i] = left[i] + width[i] 
    /\ 
    top[i] = bottom[i] + length[i]
);

% 2. Containers must fit within the deck
constraint forall(i in 1..n_containers) (
    left[i] >= 0 
    /\ 
    right[i] <= deck_width 
    /\ 
    bottom[i] >= 0 
    /\ 
    top[i] <= deck_length
);

% 3. Non-overlapping constraint between containers
constraint forall(i, j in 1..n_containers where i < j) (
    (right[i] <= left[j] \/ left[i] >= right[j]) 
    \/ 
    (top[i] <= bottom[j] \/ bottom[i] >= top[j])
);

% 4. Separation constraints between classes
constraint forall(i, j in 1..n_containers where i < j) (
    let {
        int: c1 = classes[i];
        int: c2 = classes[j];

        ( (bottom[j] - top[i] >= s) \/ (bottom[i] - top[j] >= s) )

        true
    endif
);

% 5. Loading sequence constraints (touching walls or previous containers)
constraint forall(i in 1..n_containers) (
    (left[i] == 0 \/ sum( [ (right[j] == left[i]) | j in 1..n_containers where j != i ]) >= 1 )
    /\ 
    (bottom[i] == 0 \/ sum( [ (top[j] == bottom[i]) | j in 1..n_containers where j != i ]) >= 1 )
);

solve satisfy;

% Output in JSON format
output [
    "{",
    join(",",
        [
            "\"" ++ "left" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(left[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]",
            "\"" ++ "right" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(right[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]",

            "\"" ++ "top" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(top[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]"

array[1..n_containers] of var 0..deck_length: top;

    right[i] = left[i] + width[i] 
    /\ 
    top[i] = bottom[i] + length[i]
);

% 2. Containers must fit within the deck
constraint forall(i in 1..n_containers) (
    left[i] >= 0 
    /\ 
    right[i] <= deck_width 
    /\ 
    bottom[i] >= 0 
    /\ 
    top[i] <= deck_length
);

% 3. Non-overlapping constraint between containers
constraint forall(i, j in 1..n_containers where i < j) (
    (right[i] <= left[j] \/ left[i] >= right[j]) 
    \/ 
    (top[i] <= bottom[j] \/ bottom[i] >= top[j])
);

    /\ 
    (bottom[i] == 0 \/ sum( [ (top[j] == bottom[i]) | j in 1..n_containers where j != i ]) >= 1 )
);

solve satisfy;

% Output in JSON format
output [
    "{",
    join(",",
        [
            "\"" ++ "left" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(left[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]",
            "\"" ++ "right" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(right[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]",
            "\"" ++ "bottom" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(bottom[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]",
            "\"" ++ "top" ++ "\": [" ++ join(",", [ show(top[i]) | i in 1..n_containers ]) ++ "]"

    "}"
];

];

% Include necessary libraries

array[1..n] of var 1..n: candies;

constraint forall(i in 1..n-1)(
    (ratings[i] > ratings[i+1] -> candies[i] > candies[i+1]) /\
    (ratings[i] < ratings[i+1] -> candies[i] < candies[i+1])
);

output ["{\"z\": " ++ show(sum(candies)) ++ "}"];

);

];
```
